search.purpose: Primary text entry beside compact card imagery.

label.purpose: Dataset stamps, controls, counts, and tier metadata.

components.name: Clothbound Header
components.description: Forest-cloth masthead with compass mark, book title, dataset provenance, and mountain-edge rule.
components.html:
The Hobbit Pick OrderAn expedition atlas for the next pick
188cards
19 Aug 2026
components.css: .ds-cloth-header { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 28px; min-height: 142px; padding: 18px clamp(20px, 4vw, 58px) 22px; overflow: hidden; color: var(--paper-light); background: var(--forest); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(22, 39, 31, .2); font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-cloth-brand { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 17px; } .ds-cloth-compass { width: 54px; height: 54px; color: var(--brass-light); } .ds-cloth-copy { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-cloth-copy strong { font: 700 clamp(1.8rem, 3vw, 2.7rem)/.98 "Alegreya", Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-cloth-copy small { color: #d2dacd; font-size: .82rem; } .ds-cloth-stamp { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto; align-items: center; min-width: 154px; padding: 10px 16px; color: var(--forest-deep); background: var(--brass-light); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 7px 18px rgba(22, 39, 31, .24); font-size: .72rem; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-cloth-stamp > strong { margin-right: 10px; font: 700 2.25rem/.85 "Alegreya", Georgia, serif; } .ds-cloth-mountains { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 54px; color: var(--forest-deep); }

components.name: Page Flag
components.description: Inactive forest-soft tab for turning between the picker and full atlas leaves.
components.css: .ds-page-flag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 22px; color: var(--paper-light); background: var(--forest-soft); border: 1px solid rgba(238, 228, 202, .24); border-bottom: 0; border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0; box-shadow: 0 7px 18px rgba(22, 39, 31, .16); font: 700 1rem/1.5 "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms var(--ease-out), background-color 160ms var(--ease-out), box-shadow 160ms var(--ease-out), transform 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-page-flag:hover { background: #4d6b59; } .ds-page-flag:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-page-flag:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-page-flag svg { width: 21px; height: 21px; }

components.name: Active Page Flag
components.description: Raised brass tab that identifies the open atlas leaf.
components.css: .ds-page-flag-active { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 58px; padding: 0 22px; color: var(--forest-deep); background: var(--brass-light); border: 1px solid var(--brass-light); border-bottom: 0; border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0; box-shadow: 0 7px 18px rgba(22, 39, 31, .16); font: 700 1rem/1.5 "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 160ms var(--ease-out), transform 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-page-flag-active:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-page-flag-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-page-flag-active:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-page-flag-active svg { width: 21px; height: 21px; }

components.name: Atlas Search Field
components.description: Warm map-leaf search control with forest stroke and integrated clear action.
components.css: .ds-atlas-search { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr 40px; align-items: center; min-height: 68px; padding: 0 11px 0 18px; color: var(--forest-deep); background: var(--paper-light); border: 2px solid var(--forest); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(64, 54, 37, .13); font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition: border-color 180ms var(--ease-out), box-shadow 180ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-atlas-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--oxblood); box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(64, 54, 37, .19); } .ds-atlas-search-label { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); } .ds-atlas-search-icon { width: 24px; height: 24px; } .ds-atlas-search-input { min-width: 0; height: 64px; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--forest-deep); caret-color: var(--oxblood); background: transparent; border: 0; outline: 0; font: 700 clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.25rem)/1.5 "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-atlas-search-clear { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; padding: 0; color: var(--paper-light); background: var(--forest); border: 0; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms var(--ease-out), transform 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-atlas-search-clear:hover { background: var(--oxblood); } .ds-atlas-search-clear:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-atlas-search-clear:active { transform: scale(.96); } .ds-atlas-search-clear svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; }

components.name: Pick Result Row
components.description: Flat candidate row with card thumbnail, Alegreya rank lane, identity, tier, and action.
components.css: .ds-pick-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 55px 54px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 14px; width: 100%; min-height: 82px; padding: 9px 8px 9px 2px; color: var(--ink); text-align: left; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms var(--ease-out), transform 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-pick-row:hover { background: rgba(248, 242, 223, .74); } .ds-pick-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pick-row:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-pick-thumb { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 55px; aspect-ratio: 125.3 / 176.4; color: var(--muted); background: var(--paper-deep); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 5px 13px rgba(49, 43, 32, .2); font-size: .56rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-pick-rank { align-self: stretch; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-pick-rank strong { font: 700 1.7rem/1 "Alegreya", Georgia, serif; } .ds-pick-rank small { color: var(--muted); font-size: .66rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-pick-name { display: grid; gap: 5px; min-width: 0; } .ds-pick-name strong { overflow: hidden; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.22; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-pick-name small { color: var(--muted); font-size: .72rem; } .ds-pick-meta { display: grid; justify-items: end; gap: 6px; } .ds-pick-tier { min-width: 34px; min-height: 24px; display: grid; place-items: center; color: #fff; background: #a55d40; border-radius: 999px; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-pick-action { min-width: 64px; padding: 8px 10px; color: var(--paper-light); background: var(--forest); border-radius: 6px; font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; }

components.name: Mapped Result Row
components.description: Selected result variant with a translucent brass leaf tint and oxblood state label.
components.css: .ds-mapped-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 55px 54px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 14px; width: 100%; min-height: 82px; padding: 9px 8px 9px 2px; color: var(--ink); text-align: left; background: rgba(217, 189, 116, .23); border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms var(--ease-out), transform 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-mapped-row:hover { background: rgba(217, 189, 116, .32); } .ds-mapped-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-mapped-row:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-mapped-thumb { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 55px; aspect-ratio: 125.3 / 176.4; color: var(--muted); background: var(--paper-deep); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 5px 13px rgba(49, 43, 32, .2); font-size: .56rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-mapped-rank { align-self: stretch; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-mapped-rank strong { font: 700 1.7rem/1 "Alegreya", Georgia, serif; } .ds-mapped-rank small { color: var(--muted); font-size: .66rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-mapped-name { display: grid; gap: 5px; min-width: 0; } .ds-mapped-name strong { overflow: hidden; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.22; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-mapped-name small { color: var(--muted); font-size: .72rem; } .ds-mapped-meta { display: grid; justify-items: end; gap: 6px; } .ds-mapped-tier { min-width: 34px; min-height: 24px; display: grid; place-items: center; color: #fff; background: #a55d40; border-radius: 999px; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-mapped-action { min-width: 64px; padding: 8px 10px; color: var(--paper-light); background: var(--oxblood); border-radius: 6px; font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; }

components.name: Brass Action Button
components.description: Compact pack-level action rendered as a brass waypoint on forest cloth.
components.css: .ds-brass-button { min-width: 70px; min-height: 42px; color: var(--forest-deep); background: var(--brass-light); border: 0; border-radius: 6px; font: 700 .75rem/1.15 "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms var(--ease-out), background-color 160ms var(--ease-out), transform 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-brass-button:hover:not(:disabled) { color: #fff; background: var(--oxblood); } .ds-brass-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-brass-button:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-brass-button:disabled { color: #819087; background: #344d40; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.css: .ds-route-leader { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 110px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 20px; padding: 18px; overflow: hidden; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 13px 32px rgba(18, 34, 26, .24); font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-route-mark { position: absolute; right: -26px; bottom: -12px; width: 235px; color: rgba(164, 72, 50, .34); } .ds-route-thumb { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 110px; aspect-ratio: 125.3 / 176.4; color: var(--muted); background: var(--paper-deep); border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 9px 22px rgba(43, 37, 27, .24); font-size: .62rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-route-copy { position: relative; z-index: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-route-label { color: var(--oxblood-dark); font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-route-name { max-width: 14ch; margin: 8px 0 14px; font: 700 clamp(1.9rem, 3.5vw, 3.1rem)/.94 "Alegreya", Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-route-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; } .ds-route-meta strong { color: var(--oxblood-dark); font: 700 1.45rem/1 "Alegreya", Georgia, serif; } .ds-route-meta span { display: grid; place-items: center; min-width: 34px; min-height: 24px; color: #fff; background: #604381; border-radius: 999px; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-route-remove { margin-top: 17px; padding: 8px 10px; color: var(--paper-light); background: var(--forest); border: 0; border-radius: 5px; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms var(--ease-out), transform 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-route-remove:hover { background: var(--oxblood); } .ds-route-remove:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-route-remove:active { transform: scale(.98); }

components.name: Colour Jump Chip
components.description: Sticky atlas-index pill with a colour emblem, literal group name, and card count.
components.css: .ds-colour-jump { display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: 16px auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 38px; padding: 0 11px; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper-light); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; font: 400 .76rem/1.5 "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms var(--ease-out), transform 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-colour-jump:hover { border-color: var(--forest); } .ds-colour-jump:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-colour-jump:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-colour-mark { display: block; width: 16px; height: 16px; background: #4f8198; border: 2px solid rgba(37, 48, 41, .28); border-radius: 50%; } .ds-colour-jump > span:last-child { color: var(--muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Atlas Card
components.description: Compact colour-grouped atlas entry with thumbnail, rank, title, tier, and pack state.
components.css: .ds-atlas-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 112px; padding: 11px 5px; color: var(--ink); text-align: left; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms var(--ease-out), transform 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-atlas-card:hover { background: rgba(248, 242, 223, .68); } .ds-atlas-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-atlas-card:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-atlas-card[aria-pressed="true"] { background: color-mix(in srgb, #4f8198 22%, transparent); } .ds-atlas-thumb { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 64px; aspect-ratio: 125.3 / 176.4; color: var(--muted); background: var(--paper-deep); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 5px 13px rgba(49, 43, 32, .2); font-size: .56rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-atlas-copy { display: block; min-width: 0; } .ds-atlas-rank { display: block; color: #254a5b; font: 700 1.25rem/1 "Alegreya", Georgia, serif; } .ds-atlas-copy > strong { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-size: .92rem; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-atlas-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin-top: 8px; } .ds-atlas-tier { display: grid; place-items: center; min-width: 34px; min-height: 24px; color: #fff; background: #2f644d; border-radius: 999px; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-atlas-action { color: var(--muted); font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-atlas-card[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-atlas-action { color: var(--oxblood-dark); }

narrative.overview:
The system turns a pick order into a working expedition volume. Forest-cloth binding and brass page flags frame warm map leaves; contour lines, oxblood route marks, river-blue details, and compass geometry create a sense of place without becoming decorative fantasy. It should feel learned, practical, companionable, and ready to be opened mid-journey for a quick decision.

Hierarchy remains operational inside that world. Alegreya gives titles and ranks a bookish editorial voice, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next keeps search and metadata exceptionally legible, and the open spread makes the current route as tangible as the cards being considered. The system rejects generic dashboard chrome and theatrical parchment styling; materials stay quiet enough for immediate interaction.
keyCharacteristics: Forest-cloth framing around warm, lightly contoured map leaves.
Alegreya for titles and ranks; Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for working text.
Brass page flags for navigation, provenance, and route wayfinding.
Oxblood route marks for selection and consequential state; river blue for cartographic detail.
An open two-leaf picker spread paired with a complete colour-indexed atlas.
Restrained tactile shadows that make the atlas feel handled rather than glossy.

rules.name: The Route Mark Rule
rules.body: Oxblood belongs to mapped state, route emphasis, and consequential actions; it is never a broad decorative fill.

rules.name: The Brass Flag Rule
rules.body: Brass identifies places to turn, clear, or orient. Keep it compact so it continues to read as a page flag or waypoint.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Leaves Rule
rules.body: Primary reading happens in Contour Ink on Map Leaf. Forest reversals are reserved for binding, navigation, and the current route.

rules.name: The Literary Utility Rule
rules.body: Use Alegreya for page hierarchy, card leaders, and ranks; use Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for every instruction, control, and dense list detail.

rules.name: The No-Costume Rule
rules.body: Preserve Alegreya’s natural case and editorial rhythm. Do not simulate medieval lettering with all-caps display type, blackletter, or decorative tracking.

rules.name: The Open-Volume Rule
rules.body: Picker and route belong to the same spread, while the complete atlas is a deliberate page turn—not a dashboard panel competing in the same viewport.

rules.name: The Route-in-Reach Rule
rules.body: The current leader must remain visible in the right leaf or reachable through the brass mobile dock.

rules.name: The Bound-Object Rule
rules.body: Elevate the atlas as one handled object; do not distribute independent card-panel shadows across the leaves.

rules.name: The Bound-Corner Rule
rules.body: Preserve the square flag-to-leaf join; rounding all four corners would break the open-book silhouette.

rules.name: The Map-Mark Rule
rules.body: Decorative geometry must read as navigation—compass, contour, route, mountain, or colour emblem—not as generic fantasy ornament.

dos: Do frame warm map leaves with Forest Cloth and preserve the square page-flag join.
Do reserve Oxblood for route marks, mapped state, and consequential actions.
Do use brass for page flags, provenance, route ticks, and waypoint controls.
Do keep Alegreya on titles, leaders, and ranks while Atkinson Hyperlegible Next handles working text.
Do preserve card rank, tier, Magic-colour grouping, keyboard focus, touch targets, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep contour and route imagery quiet enough that card names and ranks remain dominant.
donts: Don't substitute loud synthetic signal colours or monochrome machinery panels for the atlas palette.
Don't turn the atlas into theatrical parchment with distressed edges, blackletter, gold filigree, or lore ornament.
Don't use Oxblood or Brass as broad decorative backgrounds across the map leaves.
Don't wrap each ranked row in its own rounded, elevated card.
Don't mix picker, current route, and complete atlas into competing dashboard panels.
Don't replace literal card, rank, state, and colour labels with ambiguous icons alone.
